title: 510(k) Premarket Notification: Lumipulse G pTau217/ß-Amyloid 1-42 Plasma Ratio
one_line: The FDA has granted 510(k) clearance to Fujirebio's Lumipulse G pTau217/ß-Amyloid 1-42 Plasma Ratio assay as a substantially equivalent immunoassay blood test for amyloid pathology assessment.
summary: This document is an administrative record from the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA) 510(k) Premarket Notification database. It documents the FDA review decision for a medical device submitted by Fujirebio Diagnostics, Inc. The device, named 'Lumipulse G pTau217/ß-Amyloid 1-42 Plasma Ratio', is classified under the Immunology specialty as an immunoassay blood test for amyloid pathology assessment (Product Code: SET). The FDA received the traditional 510(k) submission (K242706) on September 9, 2024, and issued a decision of 'Substantially Equivalent' (SESE) on May 16, 2025, clearing the assay for market use.

key_claims.claim: The Lumipulse G pTau217/ß-Amyloid 1-42 Plasma Ratio device is substantially equivalent to a legally marketed predicate device.
key_claims.evidence: FDA Decision recorded as 'Substantially Equivalent (SESE)' on 05/16/2025.

funding_and_conflicts: Submitted by applicant Fujirebio Diagnostics, Inc. No specific investigator conflicts stated.
limitations: The document is a high-level regulatory clearance summary, lacking detailed methodology, performance metrics, and clinical validation data.
